-- ====================================================== -- STEP 1: CALCULATE POSTED NET ACTIVITY PER ACCOUNT -- ======================================================
WITH posted_totals AS (
SELECT le.business_id, le.account_id,
-- Debit-positive net accounting amount. SUM( le.debit - le.credit ) AS net_debit_balance
FROM ledger_entries le
-- Match each ledger entry to its transaction. -- Both identifiers are used for business safety. INNER JOIN transactions t ON t.business_id = le.business_id AND t.id = le.transaction_id
WHERE le.business_id = #{businessId}
-- Only finalized transactions affect reports. AND t.status = 'POSTED'
-- Include transactions up to the report date. AND t.transaction_date <= #{asOfDate}
GROUP BY le.business_id, le.account_id ),
-- ====================================================== -- STEP 2: INCLUDE ALL ACCOUNTS IN THE BUSINESS -- ======================================================
account_net AS (
SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.code, a.name, a.account_type, a.is_active,
-- Zero when no posted entries exist. COALESCE( pt.net_debit_balance, 0::NUMERIC ) AS net_debit_balance
FROM accounts a
-- Keep accounts without matching ledger entries. LEFT JOIN posted_totals pt ON pt.business_id = a.business_id AND pt.account_id = a.id
-- Return accounts belonging to this business. WHERE a.business_id = #{businessId} )
-- ====================================================== -- STEP 3: SPLIT NET BALANCES INTO DEBIT AND CREDIT -- ======================================================
SELECT account_id, code, name, account_type, is_active,
-- ================================================== -- DEBIT BALANCE -- ==================================================
-- A positive net amount belongs on the Debit side. -- Otherwise, the Debit balance is zero.
GREATEST( net_debit_balance, 0::NUMERIC ) AS debit_balance,
-- ================================================== -- CREDIT BALANCE -- ==================================================
-- A negative net amount represents a credit balance. -- Negate it to display a positive credit amount.
GREATEST( -net_debit_balance, 0::NUMERIC ) AS credit_balance
FROM account_net
-- ====================================================== -- STEP 4: SORT BY ACCOUNT CODE -- ======================================================
ORDER BY code, account_id
